cs.t: I have an Android phone (Droid X, old I know,) and I love it. But what's odd to me is when hardware companies fork and go without Google, they say "no-but", rather than "yes-and". "Does it have all the stock Android features?" It's often: "No, but we added ringtones, wallpapers, and our own store instead of Google's." It should be: "Yes, and we've added useful tools to increase/aid functionality."
cs.th: Android Is Suddenly In A Lot Of Trouble
